subcategory_text: Contracts with data processing ecosystem parties are used to implement appropriate measures designed to meet the objectives of an organization’s privacy program.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SR-3 (Supply Chain Controls and Processes), SR-4 (Provenance)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.20 (Addressing information security within supplier agreements), A.5.23 (Information security for use of cloud services)
Aligned with NIST CSF 2.0 GV.SC-08 (supplier agreements prioritise cybersecurity)
implementation_examples: Use written contracts (DPAs, SCCs, BAAs) with ecosystem parties to implement the measures designed to meet the privacy-programme objectives

Ensure contracts cover processing scope, security and privacy controls, breach notification, audit rights, sub-processor approval, return/deletion of data on termination, and applicable transfer mechanisms
Monitor contract performance through KPIs and review clauses on renewal
assessment_objectives: Determine whether contracts exist with data processing ecosystem parties
Determine whether contracts implement privacy-programme objectives (purpose, controls, audit, deletion)
Determine whether transfer mechanisms are addressed where applicable
Determine whether contract performance is monitored and reviewed
